resources.string: Align subtitles with dialogue when Auto Sync cannot find a reliable match (ExoPlayer only). For speech recognition to work well with English audio, we recommend add-ons that provide plenty of English subtitles for the title, even when watching subtitles in another language.
Optional, for faster and more precise sync with English audio. Downloads once on an unmetered connection when needed. Audio stays on your device.
Ready. Select to delete the downloaded model.
Download failed. Select to retry. Speech detection still works.
Read short dialogue samples ahead of playback for faster sync. Uses approximately 150 MB per title, with small read-buffer overhead. Off by default.
